description: The AI project manager's delivery status for an owned Open Label project: open suggestions (stalled-work reassignments, quality-drift rebalances) with their triggering rationale, recent batch-delivery rollups, and 30-day decision counts. Suggestions are advisory — approving/executing happens in the app's Manager panel through existing assignment controls; the agent plane can watch, triage, and dismiss. Requires jobs:read scope and the delivery_orchestration feature on the project owner.

projectId.description: The Open Label project to read delivery status for.

name: opentrain_delivery_status
